text: [photo: table plan draft]
First draft, tell me what's wrong 🙂
The table by the window is going to be freezing if the doors open every five minutes
Also is florin really at 4 with me or is that a typo
Client dinner till late tonight, sorry. Table 4 is fine, I don't mind the window
Diana, grandma should be closer to the bathroom side, she can't walk far
And your aunt's family not so near the Popescus
Yes mum, I already moved her, the second version has her by the corridor 🙂
Swap 6 and 7 if you want, let me know
where am i
ushers table or with the cousins
Ushers, table 9 with you and the cousins
ok 👍 cousins are better than ushers anyway
Just saw this. Window table is not ideal but better than the wine cellar corner. Dad will want the aisle seat again 😅
He can have the aisle, I'm not arguing with him
Diana I need the seating to be final before friday, the caterer asked
It's not final but close, I'll print tomorrow
The caterer wants the headcount by monday. I checked with the supplier guy who does weddings, he says 130 max for that room
So no more plus ones please
130 is a lot for that room. We had 110 at your cousin's wedding and it was tight
The room is fine, it's the bar line that's the problem
bar line is fine if you give us the cheap wine
No
was joking 😭
Florin, do you need to leave the group photos early for work
Out of dinner. I'll be at the group photos, I'll move a call
Sorry for the short messages, long day
Just finished service. The kitchen was chaos tonight
Diana's already asleep I guess. I'll look at the plan when I get home
Vlad is at table 9 with the cousins, that's going to be loud
i'm going to sleep soon, 6am training
Can't sleep. Who decided the first dance song was going to be that one
Never mind, I know it was Diana
Home. Diana, I saw the plan. The first dance is your choice, no complaints from me
pitch in sector 4 is flooded, training moved to the gym
kids want to know if the cousins are coming to the match on sat too 😂
Printing tonight, the home printer is out of ink again 🙂
Does the 130 include the band and the kids or just adult guests
Diana, did the church confirm the Sunday time or only the Saturday one
Morning. Supplier says the champagne is Monday, not Friday. Fixing it
Diana it's fine, I'm on the phone with him now
On shift till 4, can't look at anything before then 🙂
Larisa yes I'll be at the group photos by 14:00 at the latest
Deadline day. The council story keeps changing every hour and the Floreasca bridge closed again
Whoever said journalism was glamorous was lying
coach says i can do the venue visit saturday if its before 11
Back home. Mum, church confirmed Sunday 12:00, I'll write it on the plan
Also Tanti Ioana texted, they can't come, the youngest is sick
So 127. Good, that gives us room at the bar
bar line still getting the cheap wine btw
No
Diana, I'll call Ioana, she should still come, the kids can sit at the end
Mum she said no, leave it 🙂
I'm only saying
Sent the group photo list to Larisa. Check the grandparents are in the first batch
Florin I did that already, it's in the second batch with the cousins because of the uncle
Fine
coach wants a team photo too lol. ok sleeping
Still can't sleep. Printed plan on the fridge, Diana can you tell me if the window table is still 4
Still at work, closing. Diana's asleep, I'll see the plan in the morning
Diana, did the tablecloth order get confirmed or is that Vlad's job
Mine. Confirmed yesterday, it's the cream one 🙂 Mum go back to sleep
gym done. coach says sector 4 pitch is still underwater so sat training might move too
not sure yet
Larisa I saw your list, batch two is fine. Sorry for being annoying yesterday
Vlad, are you up? Diana won't call Ioana
Florin no worries. Uncle is in batch two because he refuses to stand on the steps 😂
Mum it's ok, she has a sick kid. Let her be 🙂
Awake, coffee. Mariana I'll call Ioana, she likes me more than she likes Diana 😅
Vlad no 🙂
Joking. Joking
Bridge is open. Council story still changing. My editor says "stay on it", which means I'm not leaving before 9
Re 130: band and kids are in the count, I checked the caterer's sheet. So 127 includes them
Good, so the bar line is still the bar line
venue visit sat 10:30 still on? mum wants to come and i said no
Yes 10:30. Mum is not coming Razvan
Printed at work. The pharmacy printer doesn't know I'm doing a wedding 🙂
Larisa table 4 is still 4, Florin is at 4 with you
Grandma by the corridor, Popescus not near the aunts. Mum I did it
I didn't say anything
Good, it's good
Batch two good. Going into a meeting, back around 18:00
bar line is fine lol
No
Filed. Going for a coffee with the desk unless someone needs me
Home. Vlad's at work till 1 so I'm making soup 🙂
Diana did you eat
Yes mum, soup
Good. Tell Vlad to eat too
Friday service. Two tables asked me about the wedding, one asked if the champagne is ours. I said Monday
Diana you should look at the florist list, they have a mistake on the arch
Out of the meeting. Client wants the contract by Monday which means I work Sunday
i'm not sleeping before 22 anyway lol. sat 10:30 venue, vlad bring the car keys
Florin I'm at the café on Dorobanti till midnight if you want to come, ugh
Diana you can read the florist mail in the morning
Still awake. Saturday is going to be a whole day
Going home. Diana sleep 🙂
